I can now like every unique song in positions 0 through 5. Before the first call, I should verify that the target songs are not already liked and that the queue is unchanged, but the problem allows already-liked songs to be liked again, so I will proceed safely.

played_song_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(song['song_id'] for song in song_queue if 0 <= song['position'] <= 5))
